name: @deepseek-ai/node-addon-system
title: Prebuilt system primitives: a Linux Landlock launcher and asynchronous POSIX flock through stable Node-API

attrs.statedReason: Cross-platform boundary for the persistent PTY backend, including ConPTY on Windows. Pulled in by @earendil-works/pi-ai (optional LLM API backend). pnpm lists them only because they ship lifecycle scripts, but those are no-ops we don't need, so we deny them — install still succeeds. JSONL durability calls MoveFileExW with write-through publication on Windows. Consumers pin 3.1.1: Koffi 3.3.2's source build fails under GCC 13 when optional prebuilts are omitted. Upgrade all consumers together after the replacement passes that build and the release packed-install check.

Native Codex and Claude tests qualify this exact release with its local patches. Office engines and their API are qualified and released together by the kit repository. Fresh pi-ai releases carry the model catalog updates that are the whole point of bumping it; waiting out the release age would defeat that. This addon release recognizes the Electron 44.7.0 Node/V8 fingerprint used by Desktop.
